For example, a 5th-rank {@spell Howling Blizzard|PC1|howling blizzard} would remain 5th-rank, but a 5th-rank {@spell Fireball|PC1|fireball} would become 4th-rank. Targets still gain all the other benefits, even if you don't reduce the spell's rank.

spells.name: Armor of Bones
entries: You ossify your physical form, mimicking the durability of bone. You gain resistance 3 to cold, electricity, fire, piercing, and slashing damage.
The resistance increases by 1.

spells.name: Battlefield Persistence
spells.trigger: You are about to attempt a saving throw, but you haven’t rolled yet.
entries: You're difficult to deter in battle. You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering save, and if the triggering save is against an {@trait Incapacitation|PC1|incapacitation} effect, it treats you as if you were 2 levels higher.

spells.name: Beastmaster Trance
spells.targets: one animal companion you can perceive
entries: You enter a trance that allows you to see through the senses of the target companion. You attempt Perception checks using your own Perception, but you share special senses the target has, such as {@rule Low-Light Vision|PC1|low-light vision}. This spell grants no special method of communication with the chosen animal.

For the duration of the trance, your own senses are muted. This lack of awareness makes you {@condition Off-guard|PC1|off-guard}. You can't take actions with the {@trait Attack|PC1|attack} or {@trait Move|PC1|move} traits.

Increase the range to 100 miles and the duration of sustained up to 10 minutes. The target can hear you through the spell, allowing you to Command the Animal or use other actions that have the {@trait Auditory|PC1|auditory} trait.
Increase the range to planetary and the duration of sustained up to 1 hour. You can communicate telepathically with the target for the duration of the trance.

spells.name: Bestial Curse
entries: You tap into the target's inner being and curse it to become a bestial version of itself. The effect is based on its Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.

{@b Success} The target's body gains minor bestial features. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be {@condition Clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1} for 1 round. When it recovers from the clumsy condition, its features revert to normal, and the spell ends.

{@b Failure} The target transforms into a bestial form for 1 hour. The target becomes clumsy 1 and gains weakness 1 to silver. It gains a claw, hoof, horn, or jaws Strike (your choice) that uses the target's unarmed Strike statistics except that the damage type changes to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing, as appropriate. Whenever the target attempts to use any {@trait Manipulate|PC1|manipulate} action, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the action is lost.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the duration is unlimited.

spells.name: Blanket of Stars
entries: A flowing cloak of utter darkness drapes over you, filled with pinpricks of light like distant stars. It imparts the stillness of the cosmos to you, granting you a +2 status bonus to {@skill Stealth|PC1} checks to {@action Hide|PC1} and {@action Sneak|PC1}. While outside under a starry night sky, you're also {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible} as long as you remain still. When moving under a starry night sky, you're {@condition Concealed|PC1|concealed} instead.
Gazing too closely into the stars is disorienting. Any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you must attempt a Will save; this is a {@trait Mental|PC1|mental}, {@trait Visual|PC1|visual} effect.
{@b Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The creature is {@condition Dazzled|PC1|dazzled} until the end of its next turn.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is {@condition Confused|PC1|confused} and dazzled until the end of its next turn.

spells.name: Blinding Fury
spells.trigger: A creature damages you.
entries: You curse the target with your outrage at being attacked. The effect is determined by the target's Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target can't observe you until the end of its turn, and if you're currently observed by it, you become {@condition Hidden|PC1|hidden} to it.
{@b Failure} As success, and for 1 minute, every time the target damages you, it can't observe you until the end of its turn.

{@b Critical Failure} As success, and for an unlimited duration, the first time each round the target damages a creature, it can't observe that creature until the end of its turn. If it damages several creatures at once, the creature it can't perceive is chosen randomly among those creatures.

spells.name: Blister
entries: You point at a target in range, and its skin grows searing blisters filled with caustic fluid. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.

{@b Success} The target grows one blister. You can spend a single action, which has the {@trait Concentrate|PC1|concentrate} trait, to pop a blister. The target and each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from the target takes 7d6 acid damage (basic Fortitude save). You choose the direction of the cone, which can't include the target. When no blisters are left, the spell ends.
{@b Failure} As success, but the target grows two blisters.
{@b Critical Failure} As success, but the target grows four blisters.
The damage of a popped blister increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Blistering Invective
entries: A heap of insults and invectives spew from your mouth—words so devastating your foes burn from the intensity of your diatribe. Your words deal 2d6 {@condition Persistent Damage|PC1|persistent fire damage}, and the target must attempt a Will save. If the target doesn't understand the language or you're not speaking a language, it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half the persistent fire damage.
{@b Failure} The target becomes {@condition Frightened|PC1|frightened 1} and takes the full persistent fire damage.
{@b Critical Failure} The target becomes frightened 2 and takes double the persistent fire damage.
You can target two additional creatures, and the persistent damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Brain Drain
entries: You probe the target's mind to glean knowledge. This deals 1d8 mental damage with a basic Will save. If the target fails the save, you sort through the stolen memories to attempt a single check to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1}. Choose a skill that has the Recall Knowledge action, and use the target's skill modifier for the check.
The mental damage increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Bullhorn
entries: You amplify your voice, loud enough for you to be heard easily at a great distance. For the duration, your voice can be heard loudly and clearly by all listeners within 500 feet, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. Despite the volume, this doesn't make your voice jarring or distracting. This doesn't increase the range or area of other {@trait Auditory|PC1|auditory} or {@trait Linguistic|PC1|linguistic} effects, and physical barriers such as walls and doors still block or muffle your voice as normal.

Your loud voice makes it easier to {@action Coerce|PC1} others, and the acoustics assist in Performing at a large venue. You gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Coerce and auditory {@skill Performance|PC1} checks to Perform at a large venue.
You can Dismiss the spell.
Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1,200 feet away.
Your voice can be heard clearly up to 1 mile away

spells.name: Carryall
entries: A small platform of magical force materializes adjacent to you to carry cargo. It is {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible} or has a ghostly appearance, is 2 feet in diameter, and follows 5 feet behind you, floating just above the ground. It holds up to 5 Bulk of objects (if they can fit on it). Any objects atop the platform fall to the ground when the spell ends. You can Sustain the spell to move the platform up to 30 feet along the ground, to make it stay in place, or to have it return to you and resume following you.

The spell ends if a creature tries to ride atop the platform, if the platform is overloaded, if anyone tries to lift or force the platform higher above the ground, or if you move more than 60 feet away from the platform.
The platform can carry 10 Bulk, creatures can ride atop it, and it can hover in the air, not just on the ground.

spells.name: Celestial Brand
entries: A blazing symbol appears on the target, cursing it to face divine justice. You and your allies receive a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls and skill checks against it. Anytime a {@trait Holy|PC1|holy} creature damages it, the holy creature deals an additional 1d4 spirit damage. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.
The spirit damage increases by 1.

spells.name: Chameleon Coat
entries: You shift the colors of the targets' outermost layer of clothing and gear to be closer to their environment when they remain still. Creatures affected by the spell gain a +3 status bonus to {@skill Stealth|PC1} checks to {@action Hide|PC1}. The changed color granted by the spell always shifts to match the environment, even if there are drastic changes. If any piece of gear or clothing affected by the spell is removed from a creature, the spell ends for that creature.

If a creature affected by this spell rolls a critical failure on its Stealth check to {@action Sneak|PC1} within 30 feet of a creature that would spot it, it instead only fails its check, as the spell mildly hypnotizes the spotter.
As 6th rank, and the status bonus is +4.

spells.name: Champion's Sacrifice
spells.trigger: An ally is hit by a Strike or fails a saving throw against an effect that doesn’t affect you.
entries: You form a link with an ally, allowing you to take harm in their stead. All the effects of the hit or failed save are applied to you instead of the target. For example, if the target critically fails a saving throw against a {@spell Fireball|PC1|fireball}, you would take double damage. These effects ignore any resistances, immunities, or other abilities you have that might mitigate them in any way, although those of the target apply before you take the effect.

spells.name: Charitable Urge
entries: You speak on the virtue of charity, compelling the target to give away its possessions. The target must attempt a Will save. If the target has no items on its person, the spell fails.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Stunned|PC1|stunned 1} as it wrestles with the urge.

{@b Failure} On its next turn, before it does anything else, the target must present the nearest creature with an item in its possession; the target chooses which item to give, and if the only item it has is one that it's currently using to defend itself, such as a weapon during a combat encounter, it can choose to be stunned for 1 round instead of giving up the item. This might require the target to Interact to retrieve an item or move to reach the nearest creature, and passing the item off requires an Interact action as normal.

{@b Critical Failure} As failure, except the duration is 4 rounds, and the target must repeat the effects of a failure on each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, ending the effects entirely on a critical success.

spells.name: Chilling Spray
entries: A cone of icy shards bursts from your spread hands and coats the targets in a layer of frost. You deal 2d4 cold damage to creatures in the area; they must each attempt a Reflex save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 2 rounds.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 2 rounds.
The damage increases by 2d4.

spells.name: Chroma Leach
entries: Your hand glows with impossible colors from beyond the stars, and your touch saps both color and vitality from the living. The target must attempt a Fortitude save; creatures with the {@trait Gnome|PC1|gnome} trait take a –2 circumstance penalty to this save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 2} for 1 round.

{@b Failure} The target is enfeebled 2 for 1 minute and {@condition Drained|PC1|drained 1}. The target is also filled with listlessness and ennui. For 1 round, if the target tries to use a {@trait Move|PC1|move} action, it must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or the action is lost; this effect has the {@trait Mental|PC1|mental} and {@trait Emotion|PC1|emotion} traits.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the creature is permanently enfeebled 2 and drained 2 (although magic such as {@spell Sound Body|PC1|sound body} can remove these conditions).

spells.name: Chthonian Wrath
entries: You evoke the energy of a part of the Outer Rifts. The damage types of the spell (one energy and one physical) are based on the result of rolling on the table below.
You deal 4d6 damage of each of the corresponding damage types to each creature in the cone (8d6 total damage).

rows: Bolts of lightning and flying debris

entries: The damage for each type increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Claim Undead
entries: You attempt to wrest control of a target {@trait Undead|PC1|undead} or force it to recognize you as its master. If the target is {@condition Controlled|PC1|controlled} by another creature, that controller attempts a Will saving throw to retain control; otherwise, the target must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Stunned|PC1|stunned 1} and {@condition Confused|PC1|confused} for 1 round as it fights off your commands.

{@b Failure} The target becomes controlled by you and follows your orders. It (or the creature previously controlling it) can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns; on a success, the spell ends, and the creature becomes stunned 1 and confused for 1 round. If you issue an obviously self-destructive order, the target doesn't act until you issue a new order.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the target (or the creature previously controlling it) receives a new save only if you give it a new order that is against its nature.

spells.name: Clinging Shadows Stance
entries: You adopt the stance of clinging shadows. You can make shadow grasp Strikes. These deal 1d4 void damage; are in the brawling group; and have the {@trait Agile|PC1|agile}, {@action Grapple|PC1|grapple}, {@trait Reach|PC1|reach}, and {@trait Unarmed|PC1|unarmed} traits. While in clinging shadows stance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to {@skill Athletics|PC1} checks to {@action Grapple|PC1}, and to the DC for creatures to {@action Escape|PC1} from you.

spells.name: Cloak of Colors
entries: A cloak of swirling colors shrouds the target. Creatures are {@condition Dazzled|PC1|dazzled} while adjacent to it, and attacking the target causes a brilliant flash of light. A creature that hits the target with a melee attack must attempt a Will save. The creature is then temporarily immune until the end of its turn; this effect has the {@trait Incapacitation|PC1|incapacitation} trait.
{@b Success} The attacker is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The attacker is {@condition Blinded|PC1|blinded} for 1 round.
{@b Critical Failure} The attacker is {@condition Stunned|PC1|stunned} for 1 round.

spells.name: Collective Transposition
entries: You teleport the targets to new positions within the area. The creatures must each be able to fit in their new space, and their positions must be unoccupied, entirely within the area, and in your line of sight. Unwilling creatures can attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target can teleport if it wants, but it chooses the destination within range.
{@b Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Failure} You teleport the target and choose its destination.
The number of targets increases by 1.

spells.name: Concordant Choir
entries: You unleash a dangerous consonance of reverberating sound, focusing on a single target or spreading out to damage many foes. The number of actions you spend Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.
{@as 1} The spell deals 1d4 sonic damage to a single enemy, with a basic Fortitude save.
{@as 2} ({@trait Manipulate|PC1|manipulate}) The spell deals 2d4 sonic damage to all creatures in a 10-foot burst, with a basic Fortitude save.
{@as 3} ({@trait Manipulate|PC1|manipulate}) The spell deals 2d4 sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot emanation, with a basic Fortitude save
The damage increases by 1d4 for the 1-action version, or 2d4 for the other versions.

spells.name: Confusing Colors
entries: A cloud of cascading, ever-changing colors manifests in the air. Creatures are {@condition Dazzled|PC1|dazzled} while inside the cloud, as are those within 20 feet of the cloud's area. A creature must attempt a Will save if it is inside the cloud when you cast it, enters the cloud, ends its turn within the cloud, or uses a {@action Seek|PC1} or Interact action on the cloud. A creature currently affected by the cloud doesn't need to attempt new saves.
{@b Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The creature is {@condition Confused|PC1|confused} for 1d4 rounds.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is {@condition Stunned|PC1|stunned} for 1d4 rounds. After the stunned condition ends, the creature is confused for the remaining duration of the spell.

spells.name: Containment
entries: You wrap a creature in an immobile force field, whether to protect it or those around it. The field blocks attacks, effects, and creatures that would pass through it, including the target. The field has Hardness 10, 40 Hit Points, and immunity to critical hits and precision damage. If the target of containment is unwilling, the effects depend on the target's Reflex save.
{@b Critical Success} The target escapes from the field as it's forming, causing it to collapse.
{@b Success} The field partially forms with 10 Hit Points instead of 40.
{@b Failure} The field has its normal effect.
The field's Hit Points are 5 higher on a success or 15 higher on a failure.

spells.name: Corrosive Muck
entries: You create two puddles of acidic slime that hinder the movement of anyone who walks through them. The area of each pool becomes greater difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in one of the pools or enters a pool during a move action it's using, it takes 8d6 acid damage with a basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails its saving throw also takes 1d6 {@condition Persistent Damage|PC1|persistent acid damage}. As normal, if a Large or larger creature starts its turn in both pools, it takes the damage only once.
Create an additional 10-foot burst.

spells.name: Countless Eyes
entries: Eyes form across the touched creature's body, allowing it to see in all directions at once. The subject can't be flanked for the spell's duration. In addition, when the subject succeeds when Seeking, it critically succeeds instead.

spells.name: Crashing Wave
entries: You summon a crashing wave that sweeps away from you. You deal 6d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area. The water also extinguishes non-magical fires in the area.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Curse of Lost Time
spells.targets: 1 Large or smaller object, {@trait Construct|PC1|construct}, or living creature
entries: You curse the target with rapid aging or erosion. The effect depends on whether the target is an object, a {@trait Construct|PC1|construct}, or a living creature. Artifact, along with objects and constructs made of precious materials (as determined by the GM), are immune.

items: {@b Construct} The construct takes 4d6 damage (basic Fortitude save). On a failure, for 1 hour, the construct is {@condition Clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1}, is {@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 1}, and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the construct's Hit Points. On a critical failure, these effects have an unlimited duration.

entries: {@b Living Creature} The living creature must attempt a Fortitude save. Ageless creatures are immune.
{@b Critical Success} The living creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The living creature briefly ages, becoming {@condition Clumsy|PC1|clumsy 1} and {@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 1} for 1 round.
{@b Failure} As success, with a duration of 1 hour.
{@b Critical Failure} As success, with an unlimited duration.

items: {@b Object} If the object is attended, its bearer can attempt a Fortitude save. If the bearer fails or the object is unattended, the object immediately takes 4d6 damage (applying Hardness normally), and the item is cursed with an unlimited duration. Until the curse ends, the item becomes shoddy and can't be Repaired, and the curse attempts to counteract any spell that would restore the object's Hit Points. {@spell Cleanse Affliction|PC1|Cleanse affliction} can target an item affected by this spell.

entries: The damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Déjà Vu
entries: You loop a thought process in the target's mind, forcing it to repeat a moment's worth of actions. The target must attempt a Will save. If the target fails, whatever actions the target uses on its next turn, it must repeat on its following turn. The actions must be repeated in the same order and as close to the same specifics as possible. For example, if the target makes an attack, it must repeat the attack against the same creature, if possible, and if the target moves, it must move the same distance and direction, if possible, on its next turn.

If the target can't repeat an action, such as Casting a Spell that has been exhausted or needing to target a creature that has died, it can act as it chooses for that action but becomes {@condition Stupefied|PC1|stupefied 1} until the end of its turn.

spells.name: Delay Affliction
entries: With a surge of healing energy, you push back against an affliction threatening the target and grant a small amount of healing. The target recovers 3d8 Hit Points. You attempt to counteract any one affliction you are aware the target has, suspending its effects for 1 hour on a success rather than removing it. The target is then temporarily immune to {@i delay affliction} for 1 day. You don't need to have identified the name of the specific affliction, but you do need to be aware of it; for instance, you couldn't delay an {@trait Ingested|GMC|ingested} {@trait Poison|PC1|poison} during its onset period unless you were aware of the poison.
The target recovers an additional 1d8 Hit Points, and you can attempt to suspend an additional affliction.

spells.name: Diabolic Edict
entries: You issue a diabolic edict, demanding the target perform a particular task and offering rewards for its fulfillment. It gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks related to performing the task. If it refuses to perform the task you proclaimed, it instead takes a –1 status penalty to all its attack rolls and skill checks.

spells.name: Dismantle
spells.targets: 1 non-magical object in your possession of 1 Bulk or less
entries: You touch an object, and it immediately disassembles itself into its component pieces. The spell fails if the target lacks component pieces (such as a statue carved from one block of stone), and using it on a dangerous object like a snare or trap typically triggers it. The object gains the {@condition Broken|PC1|broken} condition, and the component pieces become small enough to be hidden under normal clothing and armor. You can Dismiss the spell. When the spell ends, the object reassembles itself into its original form, appearing in your hand or hands if you have them free, or on the ground in front of you otherwise. Once reassembled, the object loses the broken condition, and its Hit Points return to the value the object had when you Cast the Spell.
The spell lasts for 10 minutes.
The spell lasts until your next daily preparations.

spells.name: Dragon Breath
entries: You spew energy from your mouth, dealing 5d6 damage with a basic Reflex save. The damage type depends on the magical tradition related to the dragon that influenced your bloodline: {@b arcane} force, {@b divine} spirit, {@b occult} mental, or {@b primal} fire, or your specfic Draconic Exemplar
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Dragon Wings
entries: Leathery wings sprout from your back, giving you a fly Speed of 60 feet or your Speed, whichever is faster. If you're still flying when this spell's duration would end, you float to the ground, with the effects of {@spell Gentle Landing|PC1|gentle landing}.
The duration increases to 10 minutes.

spells.name: Drain Life
entries: You close your hand and pull life energy from another creature into yourself. This deals 3d4 void damage; the target must attempt a basic Fortitude save. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the damage the target takes, after resolving its save and applying a blood magic effect if applicable. If the target's Hit Points were lower than the damage you dealt, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to their remaining Hit Points instead. The temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Dread Secret
spells.duration: until the end of your next turn
entries: You utter a powerful secret at odds with the fundamental nature of the target creatures. Choose a specific resistance or weakness with a numerical value that you believe one or more of the targets have due to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1} or previous experience with the targets, such as resistance to fire or weakness to silver. If the information is incorrect for a given target, the spell has no effect on that target. Affected targets must attempt a Will saving throw.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.

{@b Success} The creature takes 1 damage that matches the type or trait of weakness you chose (thus triggering the creature's weakness) if you chose a weakness, or loses its resistance until the end of your next turn if you chose a resistance.
{@b Failure} As success, and the creature becomes {@condition Frightened|PC1|frightened 1} from the revelation of its dread secret.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, except the creature is frightened 3.

spells.name: Dream Council
spells.targets: up to 12 creatures you know by name and have met in person
entries: When you Cast this Spell, any targets—including you—can choose to immediately fall asleep. The spell ends for any creatures that don't choose to fall asleep. Sleepers join a shared dream, where they can communicate with one another as though they were in the same room. Individual targets leave this shared dream upon awakening, and if all the targets awaken, the spell ends.

spells.name: Drop Dead
spells.trigger: A creature within range is hit by an attack from an enemy.
entries: The target appears to fall down dead, though it actually turns {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible}. Its illusory corpse remains where it fell, complete with a believable fatal wound. This illusion looks and feels like a dead body. If the target's death seems absurd—for instance, a barbarian at full health appears to be slain by 2 damage—the GM can grant the attacker an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the illusion. If the target uses {@rule Hostile Actions|PC1|hostile actions}, the spell ends. This ends the entire spell, so the illusory corpse disappears too.
The spell doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spells.name: Dull Ambition
entries: You curse the target to fail in all avenues of its life that require drive and ambition, as it inadvertently undermines its own goals at every turn. The effect is based on the target's Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} For 1 hour, the target rolls twice and uses the lower result on initiative rolls.
{@b Failure} For 1 day, the target rolls twice and uses the lower result on initiative rolls and any check to determine the success of a downtime activity.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the duration is unlimited.

spells.name: Elemental Blast
entries: You gather elemental energy and blast your foes in one of the various listed shapes of your choosing, dealing 8d6 damage. This spell deals damage according to your elemental influence (for instance, slashing for air or fire for fire) and has your element's trait.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Elemental Motion
entries: You call upon your element to propel you, improving your Speed depending on your element. This spell has your element's trait.

items: {@b Air} You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.
{@b Earth} You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet.
{@b Fire} You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.
{@b Metal} You gain a burrow Speed of 10 feet.
{@b Water} You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed and can breathe underwater.
{@b Wood} You gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.

entries: You also gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds.
The status bonus increases to +20 feet.

spells.name: Elemental Toss
entries: With a flick of your wrist, you fling a chunk of your elemental matter at your foe. Make a ranged spell attack roll, dealing 1d8 damage on a success and double damage on a critical success. This spell deals damage according to your elemental influence (for instance, slashing for air or fire for fire) and has your element's trait.
The damage increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Embrace Nothingness
entries: You empty your body of substance, becoming one with nothingness. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to your level. You move at half your normal Speed, but can move in any direction (including up and down). While moving, you have concealment. When it is not your turn and during your turn until you take an action with the {@trait Move|PC1|move} trait, you are {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible}. You can pass through solid inanimate objects as long as they are no more than 2 feet thick.

spells.name: Embrace the Pit
entries: Devil horns grow from your skull, and your skin takes on features of the devil responsible for your diabolic bloodline. You gain resistance 5 to fire and {@trait Poison|PC1|poison}, and resistance 1 to physical damage (except silver).
The resistance to fire and poison increase by 5, and the resistance to physical damage (except silver) by 2.

spells.name: Extend Blood Magic
entries: You call upon the arcane energy coursing through your blood to extend the magic it grants. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that grants you a blood magic effect that lasts for at least 1 round, you or a target gain the blood magic effect for an additional round. You can have only one extended blood magic effect at a time.

spells.name: Faerie Dust
entries: You sprinkle magical dust in the spell's area, making those within easier to trick. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the burst's radius by 5 feet.
{@b Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The creature can't use reactions and takes a –2 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, and the creature also takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.
The initial radius increases by 5 feet.

spells.name: Familiar’s Face
spells.targets: 1 willing creature that’s your animal companion or familiar
entries: The target becomes a scrying sensor, allowing you to see through its eyes, smell what it smells, and similarly use its other senses. If you Cast a Spell with the {@trait Revelation|PC1|revelation} trait that affects your senses, such as {@spell See the Unseen|PC1|see the unseen}, while this spell is active, you gain the benefit of the spell through the target's senses instead of your own. You can also speak through the target with a voice much like yours, though it takes on some of the timbre and character of the target's growls or squawks. You can use {@action Command an Animal|PC1} on the target as part of Sustaining this spell. You don't need line of sight or line of effect to your target when you Cast this Spell.

spells.name: Fey Disappearance
spells.duration: until the end of your next turn
entries: You become {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible} and ignore natural {@rule Difficult Terrain|PC1|difficult terrain} (such as underbrush). Any hostile action you use ends this invisibility, but you still ignore natural difficult terrain.
If you use a hostile action, the invisibility doesn't end.

spells.name: Fey Glamour
entries: You call upon fey glamours to cloak an area or the targets in illusion. This has the effect of either {@spell Illusory Scene|PC1|illusory scene} on the area or {@spell Illusory Disguise|PC1|illusory disguise} on the creatures, as if heightened to a rank 1 rank lower than {@i fey glamour}, and using {@i fey glamour's} range and duration.

spells.name: Final Sacrifice
spells.targets: 1 creature with the {@trait Minion|PC1|minion} trait that you summoned or permanently control
entries: You channel disruptive energies through the bond between you and your minion, causing it to violently explode. The target is immediately slain, and the explosion deals 6d6 fire damage to creatures within 20 feet of it with a basic Reflex save. If the target has the {@trait Cold|PC1|cold} or {@trait Water|PC1|water} trait, the spell deals cold damage and has the cold trait instead of the {@trait Fire|PC1|fire} trait. Attempting to cast this spell targeting a creature that you temporarily seized control of, such as an {@trait Undead|PC1|undead} commanded by {@spell Bind Undead|PC1|bind undead}, automatically fails and breaks the controlling effect.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Flaming Fusillade
entries: You call upon an endless barrage of flames, a series of explosions bursting around you like miniature suns. You cast {@spell Ignition|PC1|ignition} as part of casting {@i flaming fusillade}. For the duration of {@i flaming fusillade}, {@i ignition's} casting time is reduced from 2 actions to 1.
For the duration, you also gain a status bonus to damage dealt by {@i ignition} equal to {@i flaming fusillade's} spell rank.

spells.name: Flurry of Claws
spells.targets: 2 creatures no more than 10 feet from each other
entries: Vicious dragon claws appear and slash at two nearby foes. Make a spell attack roll against each creature. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you've made both attacks. On a hit, the creatures takes 1d8 slashing plus 1d4 additional damage of a type determined by the magical tradition related to the dragon that influenced your bloodline: {@b arcane} force, {@b divine} spirit, {@b occult} mental, {@b primal} fire, or your specfic Draconic Exemplar
The initial damage increases by 1d8 and the additional damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Fungal Infestation
entries: Toxic spores swarm over creatures in the area, causing them to erupt in grotesque fungal growths. These noxious growths deal 2d6 {@condition Persistent Damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}, and each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half the persistent poison damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes the full persistent poison damage. While it's taking this persistent poison damage, it has weakness 1 to fire and weakness 1 to slashing.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but double the persistent poison damage. While it's taking this persistent poison damage, it has weakness 2 to fire and weakness 2 to slashing.
The persistent damage increases by 2d6, and the weakness increases by 1, or by 2 on a critical failure.

spells.name: Gale Blast
entries: Wind flows from your outstretched hands and whirls around you in a 5-foot emanation. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage, with a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.
The damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Ghostly Tragedy
entries: This spell compels local spirits to reenact a violent event of the recent past that you're aware of and name as you Cast the Spell. You take the role of the primary victim. The reenactment plays out the final 9 minutes leading up to the death or injury of the victim and the minute after. The spirits don't change form, so this doesn't help determine perpetrators by their looks. Spiritual forms of missing creatures necessary for the event manifest as needed, and missing items appear as shadowy outlines.

Once the scene ends, you take 2d6 void damage for each ghostly apparition that participated in the scene (typically equal to the number of creatures involved other than the victim). Any creature that observed the ghostly recreation, including you, can attempt checks to investigate the event to discover new clues and information.

spells.name: Ghoulish Cravings
entries: You touch the target to afflict it with the overwhelming desire to eat raw meat. The target must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Sickened|PC1|sickened 1} by its unbidden hunger.

{@b Failure} The target is sickened 2 and can't reduce this condition below sickened 1 until it first consumes some raw meat; if the creature doesn't have access to raw meat, it can take a bite out of a corpse within reach as an Interact action.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the target can't reduce the condition below sickened 2 until it consumes raw meat.

spells.name: Glutton's Jaws
entries: A slavering maw opens beneath a target and tries to take a bite out of them. Make a spell attack roll. On a hit, the mouth deals 2d6 piercing damage, and you gain 1d4 temporary Hit Points that last until the beginning of your next turn.
The damage increases by 2d6, and the temporary Hit Points increase by 1d4.

spells.name: Grasping Grave
entries: Hundreds of skeletal arms erupt from the ground in the area, clawing at creatures within and attempting to hold them in place. The skeletal arms deal 6d6 slashing damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and is {@condition Immobilized|PC1|immobilized} for 1 round or until it {@action Escape|PC1|Escapes}.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Gravity Well
entries: You create a sphere of altered gravity. All creatures and unsecured objects in the area move toward the center, depending on their Reflex saving throws. This follows the rules for {@rule Forced Movement|PC1|forced movement}. If there's not enough space near the center of the sphere, creatures and objects nearer to the center move first, and others move as far as they can without being blocked, up to the amount set by their saving throw outcomes.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature moves 5 feet toward the center.
{@b Failure} The creature moves 15 feet toward the center.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature moves 30 feet toward the center.

spells.name: Grisly Growths
entries: This gruesome spell causes the target to grow excess limbs and organs, whether it be fingers multiplying until hands resemble bushes, eyes popping open in bizarre places, legs sprouting from the side of the body, or some other result. The target takes 10d6 piercing damage (basic Fortitude save) as the new features erupt. This spell has no effect on a target with a mutable anatomy or no limbs, such as an {@trait Ooze|PC1|ooze} or a {@trait Protean|GMC|protean}. The growths rot rapidly and fall away after 1 round.

In addition, unless the initial target critically succeeds, creatures within 30 feet of the target, including the target, must attempt Will saves, after which they're temporarily immune to this secondary effect of {@i grisly growths} for 1 hour. This additional effect is a {@trait Mental|PC1|mental} and {@trait Visual|PC1|visual} effect.
{@b Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The creature is {@condition Sickened|PC1|sickened 1}.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is sickened 2.
The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Harmonize Self
entries: You heal yourself in one of the following ways, chosen by you when you cast the spell.

items: You regain 8 Hit Points.
You attempt to cure one {@trait Poison|PC1|poison} or {@trait Disease|PC1|disease} afflicting you; attempt to counteract the affliction.

entries: If you choose to regain Hit Points, the Hit Points regained increase by 8.

spells.name: Haunting Hymn
entries: You echo a jarring hymn that only creatures in the area can hear. The hymn deals 1d8 sonic damage, with a basic Fortitude save. If a target critically fails the save, it's also {@condition Deafened|PC1|deafened} for 1 minute.
The damage increases by 1d8.

spells.name: Hellfire Plume
entries: You call forth a plume of hellfire that erupts from below, dealing 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 spirit damage.
The fire and spirit damage each increase by 1d6.

spells.name: Hero's Defiance
spells.trigger: An attack would bring you to 0 Hit Points.
entries: You shout in defiance and are filled with a burst of healing. Just before applying the attack's damage, you recover 6d8+20 Hit Points. If this is enough to prevent the attack from bringing you to 0 Hit Points, you don't become {@condition Unconscious|PC1|unconscious} or dying. Either way, cheating death is difficult, and you can't use {@i hero's defiance} again until you {@action Refocus|PC1} or make your daily preparations. {@i Hero's defiance} can't be used against effects with the {@trait Death|PC1|death} trait or that would leave no remains, such as {@spell Disintegrate|PC1|disintegrate}.

spells.name: Holy Cascade
entries: You call upon sacred energy to amplify a vial of holy water, tossing it an incredible distance. It explodes in an enormous burst that deals 3d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area from the cascade of water. The water deals an additional 6d6 spirit damage to creatures with the {@trait Unholy|PC1|unholy} trait in the area.
The bludgeoning damage increases by 1d6, and the additional spirit damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Horrific Visage
entries: You briefly transform your features into the horrific visage of a hag, striking fear into your enemies. Foes in the area must attempt a Will save.
{@b Success} The foe is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The foe is {@condition Frightened|PC1|frightened 1}.
{@b Critical Failure} The foe is frightened 2.
Foes in the area are frightened 1 on a success, frightened 2 on a failure, and frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round on a critical failure. They are still unaffected on a critical success.

spells.name: Ice Storm
entries: You create a gray storm cloud that pelts creatures with an icy deluge. When you Cast the Spell, a burst of magical hail deals 2d8 bludgeoning damage and 2d8 cold damage to each creature in the area below the cloud (basic Reflex save). Snow and sleet continue to rain down in the area for the remainder of the spell's duration, making the area {@rule Difficult Terrain|PC1|difficult terrain}. Any creature that ends its turn in the storm takes 2 cold damage. If you Cast this Spell outdoors, you can create two nonoverlapping clouds instead of one. As normal, if a Large or larger creature is in both clouds, it still only takes the initial damage once and the continuing damage once per turn.
The initial bludgeoning damage and cold damage increase by 1d8 each, and the cold damage creatures take at the end of their turns increases by 1.

spells.name: Imaginary Lockbox
spells.targets: 1 container and its contents, totaling 10 Bulk or less
spells.duration: until the next time you make your daily preparations
entries: You turn a container and its contents into an imaginary form stored in your mind that only you can see and interact with. The container's physical properties—the material from which it's made, any locks, or other features—are irrelevant to the casting of this spell, but the container can't contain any creatures. The container has no Bulk, and you can visualize everything inside it.

You can retrieve an item from the lockbox as an activity that takes 3 actions and has the {@trait Concentrate|PC1|concentrate} and {@trait Manipulate|PC1|manipulate} traits. Putting items back isn't possible. You can Dismiss the spell. When the spell ends, the container returns to its normal state, either appearing in your hands if it can fit there or on the ground adjacent to you if not.

spells.name: Imprint Message
entries: You project psychic vibrations onto the target object, imprinting it with a short message or emotional theme of your design. This imprinted sensation is revealed to a creature who casts {@spell Object Reading|PC2|object reading} on the target object, replacing any emotional events the item was present for. If the object is in the area of a {@spell Retrocognition|PC1|retrocognition} spell, the imprinted messages appear as major events in the timeline, but they don't interfere with any other visions.

If the object is targeted with {@spell Read Aura|PC1|read aura} of a higher spell rank than {@i imprint message}, the caster learns that the object has been magically modified. When you Cast this Spell, any prior vibrations placed on an object by previous castings of {@i imprint message} fade.

spells.name: Incendiary Aura
entries: You surround yourself with a combustible aura. Each time a creature within the emanation takes fire damage, it catches on fire, taking 2d4 {@condition Persistent Damage|PC1|persistent fire damage}.
The persistent damage increases by 1d4 and the radius of the emanation increases by 5 feet.

spells.name: Inner Upheaval
entries: You focus your qi into devastating magical attacks. Make an unarmed Strike or {@action Flurry of Blows|PC2} (this doesn't change the limit on using only one {@trait Flourish|PC1|flourish} per turn). You gain a +1 status bonus to your attack rolls with the Strikes, and the Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage. This damage can be any of the following types of your choice, chosen each time you Strike: force, spirit, vitality, or void.
The extra damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Interstellar Void
entries: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemy. The target is cloaked in the freezing void, which deals 3d6 cold damage immediately and the first time each round you Sustain the spell on future turns, with a basic Fortitude save. The target is fatigued for as long as the effect persists.
The cold damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Invisible Item
entries: You make the object {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible}. This makes it {@condition Undetected|PC1|undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it {@condition Hidden|PC1|hidden} to them instead if they succeed. If the item is used as part of a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed. Making a weapon invisible typically doesn't give any advantage to the attack, except that an invisible thrown weapon or piece of ammunition can be used for an attack without necessarily giving information about the attacker's hiding place unless the weapon returns to the attacker.
The duration is until the next time you make your daily preparations.
The duration is unlimited.

spells.name: Jealous Hex
entries: You draw forth a hag's innate jealousy to deny a target its greatest attribute. The target is cursed with an adverse condition depending on its highest attribute modifier: Strength ({@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled}); Dexterity ({@condition Clumsy|PC1|clumsy}); Constitution ({@condition Drained|PC1|drained}); or Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma ({@condition Stupefied|PC1|stupefied}). On a tie, the creature decides which of the conditions associated with the tied attributes to take. The target must attempt a Will save. At the start of each of your turns, the target can attempt another Will save, ending the effect on a success.
{@b Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Failure} The condition's value is 1.
{@b Critical Failure} The condition's value is 2.

spells.name: Lay on Hands
spells.targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
entries: Your hands become infused with powerful vitality, capable of healing a living creature or damaging an {@trait Undead|PC1|undead} creature with a touch.

items: {@b Willing Living Creature} The target regains 6 Hit Points. If the target is someone other than yourself, it also gains a +2 status bonus to AC for 1 round.
{@b Undead Creature} The target takes 1d6 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save; on a failure, the target also takes a –2 status penalty to AC for 1 round.

entries: The amount of healing increases by 6, and the damage to an undead target increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Leaden Steps
entries: You partially transform a foe's feet into unwieldy slabs of metal, slowing their steps. The target attempts a Fortitude saving throw.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target is {@condition Encumbered|PC1|encumbered} and has weakness 2 to electricity until the end of your next turn. The spell can't be sustained.
{@b Failure} The target is encumbered and has weakness 2 to electricity.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is encumbered and has weakness 3 to electricity.
The weakness increases by 1.

spells.name: Life Link
entries: You forge a connection of life energy between you and your target, distributing harm between both of you. When you first Cast the Spell, the target recovers 1d4 Hit Points. The first time each round that the target takes damage, reduce the damage it takes by 3 (to a minimum of 0 damage). You lose 3 Hit Points each time, or the total damage dealt, if less than 3; this damage ignores any immunities or resistances you have and can't otherwise be mitigated in any way.
The spell ends immediately if you fall {@condition Unconscious|PC1|unconscious}. You can Dismiss the spell.
You can target 2 creatures other than you. The initial healing increases to 3d4, and the maximum damage reduced and Hit Points lost increases to 5.
You can target 3 creatures other than you. The initial healing increases to 6d4, and the maximum damage reduced and Hit Points lost increases to 10.
You can target 4 creatures other than you. The initial healing increases to 9d4, and the maximum damage reduced and Hit Points lost increases to 15.

spells.name: Life-Giving Form
entries: You transcend your physical form, becoming a beacon of healing energy. Your body exudes {@rule Bright Light|PC1|bright light} like a {@equipment Torch|PC1|torch}. You gain resistance 5 to precision damage and weakness 5 to void damage, and your {@trait Unarmed|PC1|unarmed} Strikes deal an extra 1d4 vitality damage.

You can touch a living creature with an Interact action to restore 6d8 Hit Points to it, and when a creature touches you with an Interact action you can allow it to gain the same healing; either way, the creature becomes temporarily immune to {@i life-giving form's} healing for 1 minute. This is a {@trait Vitality|PC1|vitality} {@trait Healing|PC1|healing} effect. You can't heal yourself with life-giving form. A creature harmed by vitality damage (such as an {@trait Undead|PC1|undead}) that touches you or damages you with an {@trait Unarmed|PC1|unarmed} attack or non-{@trait Reach|PC1|reach} melee weapon instead takes 3d4 vitality damage, and it doesn't become temporarily immune.
You can Dismiss this spell.
The Hit Points restored with an Interact action increases by 1d8, the vitality damage increases by 1, and the resistance and weakness increases by 1.

spells.name: Lifewood Cage
entries: You create an immobile, invisible prison of hardened wood suffused with vital energy from the Forge of Creation. The cage is a 20-foot cube made of wooden branches, each a half inch thick and a half inch apart. Each creature in the area where you create the cage must attempt a Reflex save. If such a creature fails, it becomes trapped inside the cage. If it succeeds, it's pushed outside the cage into a space of its choice. If a creature in the area is too big to fit inside the prison, the spell automatically fails.

The cage has AC 10, Hardness 20, and 40 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage, though it has weakness 5 to void damage. A creature capable of passing through the space between the bars (typically a Tiny creature) can leave; all others are confined within. The vitality energy suffusing the wood prevents {@trait Incorporeal|GMC|incorporeal} {@trait Undead|PC1|undead} creatures from passing through the beams. Attacks with a weapon too large to fit between the bars can't pass through the cage, and the bars provide standard cover even against attacks that can pass through the gaps. Spells and most area effects (such as {@spell Dragon Breath|PC2|dragon breath}) can pass through the cage uninhibited.

spells.name: Lightning Storm
entries: You create a black, rumbling storm cloud and call down one lightning bolt within the spell's area. The bolt is a vertical line from the top of the storm cloud to the ground below, dealing 4d12 electricity damage to creatures in the line (basic Reflex save). On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the spell each round, you can call another lightning bolt within the area. If you Cast this Spell outdoors, you can create two nonoverlapping clouds instead of one, though you can still call down only one bolt per turn.
The damage of each bolt increases by 1d12.

spells.name: Live Wire
entries: You conjure up a length of sharp copper filament humming with electrical current that strikes out at your foe. The wire deals 1d4 slashing damage and 1d4 electricity damage, depending on your spell attack roll against the target's AC.
{@b Critical Success} The target takes double damage and 1d4 persistent electricity damage.
{@b Success} The target takes full damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes the electricity damage, but not the slashing damage.
{@b Critical Failure} The target is unaffected.
The slashing damage, initial electricity damage, and persistent electricity damage on a critical hit each increase by 1d4.

spells.name: Medusa's Wrath
entries: You make an attack filled with a medusa's petrifying power. Make an {@trait Unarmed|PC1|unarmed} Strike with the following additional effects.

{@b Critical Success} The target is {@condition Slowed|PC1|slowed 2} and must attempt a Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the {@trait Incapacitation|PC1|incapacitation} trait. On a failed save, the slowed condition increases by 1 (2 on a critical failure). A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1. When a creature is unable to act due to the slowed condition from medusa's wrath, it is {@condition Petrified|PC1|petrified} permanently. The spell ends if the creature is petrified or the slowed condition is removed.
{@b Success} As critical success, but the target is initially slowed 1.

spells.name: Moonlight Bridge
entries: You summon a bridge of radiant, shimmering moonlight. The 10-foot-wide span must start at the ground on a point within range, and it extends as a horizontal plane, either in a straight line or at any angle up to 45 degrees upward or downward, for up to 120 feet. This bridge has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to all damage (except {@trait Force|PC1|force}, {@trait Spirit|PC1|spirit}, and damage from Strikes with the ghost touch property rune). You and your allies can cross the bridge normally, but other creatures simply pass through it if they try to do so. The bridge blocks physical, ethereal, and incorporeal attacks from crossing through it, whether from above or below. You can Dismiss the spell.
The length of the bridge increases by 20 feet, its Hit Points increase by 20, and you can increase the width of the span by up to an additional 5 feet.

spells.name: Mud Pit
spells.area: squares on the ground in a 15-foot burst
entries: Thick, clinging mud covers the ground, 1 foot deep. The mud is {@rule Difficult Terrain|PC1|difficult terrain}.

spells.name: Nature’s Enmity
entries: Animals, plants, and fungi in the area turn against the targets. Each target suffers from the following effects as long as it remains in the area.

items: Vegetation springs up from every surface, giving each target a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed any time it's adjacent to the plants and fungi.

Aggressive animals attack unpredictably. At the start of its turn, each target rolls a DC 8 flat check. On a failure, it's attacked by creatures that deal 2d10 slashing damage. The target attempts a basic Reflex save and is {@condition Off-guard|PC1|off-guard} for 1 round on any outcome other than a critical success.

The target loses any connection to nature or natural creatures. The target must succeed at a DC 5 flat check when casting any {@trait Primal|PC1|primal} spell or the spell fails. Furthermore, {@trait Animal|PC1|animal}, {@trait Fungus|PC1|fungus}, and {@trait Plant|PC1|plant} creatures become {@condition Hostile|PC1|hostile} to it, even one with a strong bond to the target, such as an animal companion.

entries: The GM might decide that you can't subject some creatures, such as an emissary of a nature deity, to the ire of nature.

spells.name: Noxious Vapors
entries: You emit a cloud of toxic smoke that temporarily obscures you from sight. Each creature except you in the area when you Cast the Spell takes 1d6 poison damage (basic Fortitude save). A creature that critically fails the saving throw also becomes {@condition Sickened|PC1|sickened 1}. All creatures in the area become {@condition Concealed|PC1|concealed}, and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within it. This smoke can be dispersed by a strong wind.
The damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Object Reading
entries: You place a hand on an object to learn a piece of information about an emotional event that occurred involving the object within the past week, determined by the GM. If you cast object reading on the same item multiple times, you can either concentrate on a single event to gain additional pieces of information about that event or gain a piece of information about another emotional event in the applicable time frame.
You can learn about an event that occurred within the last month.
You can learn about an event that occurred within the last year.
You can learn about an event that occurred within the last decade.
You can learn about an event that occurred within the last century.
You can learn about an event that occurred within the entirety of the object's history.

spells.name: Phantasmal Treasure
entries: A phantasmal image of the most precious thing imaginable to the target appears in a location of your choice within the spell's range. Only the spell's target can see the treasure, though you can see the vague shape of the treasure—be it a pile of items, a deific avatar, or a cherished loved one or hero. The target's response to the treasure is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.

{@b Success} The target becomes {@condition Fascinated|PC1|fascinated} with the treasure, and the duration is until the end of its turn. The target can also try to disbelieve the illusion if it touches the treasure, {@action Seek|PC1|Seeks} to examine it, or speaks to it if the illusion appears to be a person or the like. If the target disbelieves the illusion, the spell ends.
{@b Failure} As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

{@b Critical Failure} As success, but the duration is 1 minute. The target finds the treasure so appealing that until the spell ends, it must spend each action focused on it. This can include moving toward the treasure if the target isn't next to it and Interacting with the treasure if the target is next to it. (If the illusion appears to be a person or the like, the target can also Interact to converse with it.)

spells.name: Primal Herd
spells.targets: you and up to 5 willing targets
entries: Summoning the power of the natural world, you transform the targets into a herd of mammoths, and they each assume a Huge battle form. Each target must have enough space to expand into or the spell fails for that target. Each target gains the animal trait. Each target can Dismiss the spell's effects on itself. Each target gains the following while transformed.

items: AC = 22 + the target's level. Ignore any armor check penalty and Speed reduction.
20 temporary Hit Points.
Speed 40 feet.
{@rule Low-Light Vision|PC1|Low-light vision}.

entries: The following unarmed melee attacks, which are the only attacks the target can use to Strike. When Striking with these attacks, the target uses their attack modifier with the proficiency and item bonuses of their most favorable weapon or unarmed Strike, and the damage is listed for each attack. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example).

{@b Melee} {@as 1} tusk ({@trait Reach|PC1|reach 15 feet}), Damage 4d8+19 piercing; {@b Melee} {@as 1} trunk ({@trait Agile|PC1|agile}, {@trait Reach|PC1|reach 15 feet}), Damage 4d6+16 bludgeoning; {@b Melee} {@as 1} foot ({@trait Agile|PC1|agile}, {@trait Reach|PC1|reach 15 feet}), Damage 4d6+13 bludgeoning.

items: Athletics modifier of +30, unless the target's own modifier is higher.
Each target can use the Trample action.

{@b Trample} {@as 3} You move up to twice your Speed and move through the space of Large or smaller creatures, trampling each creature whose space you enter. A trampled creature takes damage from your foot Strike based on a basic Reflex save (DC = 19 + your level).

spells.name: Protector Tree
entries: A Medium tree suddenly grows in an unoccupied square within range. The tree has AC 10 and 10 Hit Points. Whenever an ally adjacent to the tree is hit by a Strike, the tree interposes its branches and takes the damage first. Any additional damage beyond what it takes to reduce the tree to 0 Hit Points is dealt to the original target. The tree isn't large enough to impede movement through its square.

If the tree is in soil and survives to the end of the spell's duration, it remains as an ordinary, non-magical tree and continues to grow and thrive. The GM might determine that the tree disappears immediately in certain inhospitable situations.
The tree has an additional 10 Hit Points.

spells.name: Puff of Poison
entries: You exhale a shimmering cloud of toxic breath at an enemy's face. The target takes 1d4 poison damage and 1d4 {@condition Persistent Damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}, depending on its Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target takes half initial damage and no persistent damage.
{@b Failure} The target takes full initial and persistent damage.
{@b Critical Failure} The target takes double initial and persistent damage.
The initial poison damage increases by 1d4, and the persistent poison damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Qi Blast
entries: You unleash your qi as a powerful blast that deals 2d6 force damage. If you use 2 actions to cast {@i qi blast}, increase the size of the cone to 30 feet and the damage to 3d6. If you use 3 actions to cast {@i qi blast}, increase the cone to 60 feet and the damage to 4d6. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is pushed 5 feet.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and is pushed 10 feet.
The damage increases by 1d6, or by 2d6 if you use 2 or 3 actions.

spells.name: Qi Form
entries: Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special qi form. In your qi form, your hair, feathers, skin, or scales change color and begin to glow. In this form, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. Choose force, spirit, vitality, or void damage. All your Strikes deal 1d6 additional damage of the chosen type. Your entire body is also surrounded by a glowing corona of the same color as your inner qi; this is a {@trait Light|PC1|light} effect. Your corona is an aura in a 5-foot emanation that deals 2d6 damage of the chosen type to creatures who start their turn within the emanation. If the emanation overlaps with a {@trait Darkness|PC1|darkness} effect, the corona's glow attempts to counteract the darkness. Regardless of the outcome, the corona can't attempt to counteract that effect again for 1 day. You can Sustain to flare your corona out to become a 30-foot emanation or return the corona to a 5-foot emanation.

In your qi form, your emotions surge to the forefront, and it's difficult to moderate your attacks. Your weapons and unarmed attacks lose the {@trait Nonlethal|PC1|nonlethal} trait. You take a –2 status penalty to saves against {@trait Emotion|PC1|emotion} effects but gain a +2 status bonus to saves against all other {@trait Mental|PC1|mental} effects.

spells.name: Qi Rush
entries: Accelerated by your qi, you move with such speed you become a blur. Move two times: two Strides, two Steps, or one Stride and one Step (in either order). You gain the {@condition Concealed|PC1|concealed} condition during this movement and until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Reaper’s Lantern
entries: You call forth a ghostly lantern that guides the living toward death and the undead toward true death. It sheds bright light in the spell's area and dim light to twice that area. The lantern is insubstantial and floats near you, suspended from an ephemeral, skeletal hand. Living creatures and {@trait Undead|PC1|undead} in the area when you Cast the Spell, or that enter the area later, must attempt Fortitude saves. Living creatures that fail their Fortitude saves gain only half the normal benefit from {@trait Healing|PC1|healing} effects while within the area. Undead targets that fail their Fortitude saves become {@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 1} while within the area. Once a creature attempts a save against reaper's lantern, it uses the same outcome if it leaves the area and enters it again.

Once per turn, starting on the round after you cast {@i reaper's lantern}, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. When you do so, you force creatures in the area that haven't yet attempted a save against {@i reaper's lantern} to attempt one.

spells.name: Resplendent Mansion
entries: You conjure a towering mansion up to four stories tall and up to 300 feet on a side. While Casting the Spell, you hold an image of the mansion and its desired appearance in your mind. The mansion can contain as many or as few rooms as you desire, and it's decorated as you imagine it. You can imagine a purpose for each room of the mansion, and the proper accouterments appear within. Any furniture or other mundane fixtures function normally for anyone inside the mansion, but they cease to exist if taken beyond its walls. No fixture created with this spell can create magical effects, but magical devices brought into the mansion function normally.

Your mansion contains the same types and quantities of foodstuffs and servants as created by the {@spell Planar Palace|PC1|planar palace} spell. Each of the mansion's exterior doorways and windows are protected by {@spell Alarm|PC1|alarm} spells. You choose whether each alarm is audible or mental as you Cast the Spell, and each has a different sound (for an audible alarm) or sensation (for a mental one), allowing you to instantly determine which portal has been used.

spells.name: Revel in Retribution
entries: Time seems to slow for you, allowing you to strike your opponents mid-move. You gain the {@action Reactive Strike|PC1} ability, and you immediately gain a second reaction that you can use only to use Reactive Strike. At the start of each of your subsequent turns when you regain your actions, you gain an additional reaction that can be used only to attempt a Reactive Strike.

Lashing out at a defenseless enemy invigorates you with the thrill of combat, granting you 5 temporary Hit Points whenever you successfully hit with a Reactive Strike. The temporary Hit Points last for the spell's duration.
The temporary Hit Points you gain from a successful Reactive Strike increase by 1.

spells.name: Rouse Skeletons
entries: Misshapen skeletal forms erupt from a solid surface, such as a stone floor, and fill the burst. The area they fill is difficult terrain. Their grasping claws deal 2d6 slashing damage to creatures on the ground in the area when the skeletons first appear with a basic Reflex save.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area of skeletons up to 20 feet within the range of the spell and deal 2d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save to each creature in the new area.
Damaging or destroying the skeletons is irrelevant, as new bones pull forth from the ground to repair and replace any that are obliterated.
The damage increases by 1d6.

spells.name: Sacred Form
entries: You focus all your divine energy and transform yourself into a battle form, similar to your normal form and of the same size as you, but wielding powerful divine armaments. While in this form, you gain the statistics and abilities listed below. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell.
You gain the following statistics and abilities.

items: AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
10 temporary Hit Points.
Speed 40 feet.
Resistance 3 against physical damage.
{@creatureability Darkvision|MC1}.

A special attack with a sacred armament, which is the only attack you can use. Your attack modifier with the sacred armament is +21, and your damage bonus is +8 (or +6 for a ranged attack). The damage dice for Strikes with the weapon are 3d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 spirit damage. If you have a deity, you can have the weapon take the form of your deity's favored weapon and use its damage die size, damage type, and traits. If the favored weapon is a simple weapon with 1d4 or 1d6 damage die, the weapon damage dice are one size larger than normal, though the spirit damage is unchanged. You can also use your attack modifier with this favored weapon if it's higher than that given by the spell.
{@skill Athletics|PC1} modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

entries: You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary Hit Points, resistance 4 against physical damage, attack modifier +28, damage bonus +15 (+12 for a ranged attack), and Athletics +29. If you're Medium or smaller, your battle form is Large, and your attacks also have 10-foot {@trait Reach|PC1|reach}, or 15-foot reach if you're using a favored weapon with reach.

spells.name: Scatter Scree
entries: A jumble of rocks cascades into the area. The scattering rocks deal 2d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). The ground in the area becomes {@rule Difficult Terrain|PC1|difficult terrain} for the duration of the spell. A creature can Interact to clear a square of this scree.
If you cast this spell again, any previous {@i scatter scree} you've cast ends.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Schadenfreude
spells.trigger: You critically fail a saving throw against a foe’s effect.
entries: You distract your enemy with their feeling of smug pleasure when you fail catastrophically. It must attempt a Will save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature is distracted by its amusement and takes a –1 status penalty on Perception checks and Will saves for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The creature is overcome by its amusement and is {@condition Stupefied|PC1|stupefied 1} for 1 round.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature is lost in its amusement and is stupefied 2 for 1 round and stunned 1.

spells.name: Scintillating Safeguard
spells.trigger: An effect would deal physical or energy damage to you or a creature in range
spells.targets: up to 5 willing creatures who would be harmed by the triggering effect
entries: A sparkling magical barrier envelops each target, shielding them against the triggering effect. Choose one type of physical or energy damage the triggering effect deals. Each target gains resistance 10 against that damage type for the triggering effect. The resistance applies only against the initial damage, not against any persistent damage or other lingering effects.
The resistance increases by 1.

spells.name: Seal Fate
entries: You utter a curse that a creature will meet a certain end—a death by freezing, stabbing, or another means you devise. Choose one type of damage from the following list: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, sonic, or void. The effect is based on the target's Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The target is unaffected.
{@b Success} The target gains weakness 2 to the chosen damage type until the end of your next turn.
{@b Failure} As success, but the duration is 1 minute. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the chosen damage and its level is 7 or less, it dies.
{@b Critical Failure} As failure, but the duration is unlimited.
The weakness increases by 1, and the maximum level of creature that can be automatically killed increases by 4.

spells.name: Shadow's Web
spells.requirements: You are in {@spell Clinging Shadows Stance|PC2|clinging shadows stance}.
entries: Grasping darkness surges from you, dealing 14d4 void damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage and is {@condition Enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 1} for 1 round.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and is enfeebled 2 for 1 round.

{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage, is {@condition Stunned|PC1|stunned 1}, and enfeebled 2 for 1 round, and {@condition Immobilized|PC1|immobilized} for 1 round or until it {@action Escape|PC1|Escapes}, whichever comes first.
The void damage increases by 2d4.

spells.name: Shared Invisibility
spells.targets: you and up to 5 willing creatures
entries: You and all targets are {@condition Invisible|PC1|invisible} except to each other as long as the targets remain within the emanation. If a creature made invisible by this spell leaves the spell's area, it becomes visible and remains so even if it returns to the spell's area. If any creature made invisible by this spell uses a hostile action, the spell ends after the hostile action is completed.
The targets increase to you and up to 10 willing creatures. The duration increases to 1 hour.

spells.name: Shields of the Spirit
entries: You {@action Raise a Shield|PC1|Raise your Shield}, causing ephemeral spirit shields to float within your champion's aura. The shields last until the start of your next turn or until you're no longer raising your shield, whichever comes first. While one of your allies is in your champion's aura, the shields grant them a +1 status bonus to AC, and each time an enemy makes an attack against the ally, the enemy takes 1d4 spirit damage (even if it misses).

The benefit applies only while an ally is in your aura, ending for any ally that leaves and applying to any that enters later. As normal, you don't count as your own ally and therefore don't get the benefits of the spirit shields yourself.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Shrink Item
spells.targets: 1 non-magical object up to 20 cubic feet in volume and up to 80 Bulk
entries: You shrink the target to roughly the size of a coin with negligible Bulk. You can Dismiss the spell, and the spell ends if you toss the object onto a solid surface. The object can't be used to attack or cause damage during the process of it returning to normal size. If there isn't room for the object to return to normal size when the spell ends, the spell's duration continues until the object is in a location large enough to accommodate its normal size.

spells.name: Shrink the Span
entries: The world seems to shrink before your footfalls. You teleport up to a distance equal to your Speed within your line of sight.

spells.name: Soul Siphon
entries: You siphon off a portion of the target's soul to bolster your own vitality. The target must attempt a Fortitude save or take 1d4 void damage. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the total amount of HP the target loses, including the HP lost from becoming {@condition Drained|PC1|drained}.
{@b Critical Success} The creature is unaffected.
{@b Success} The creature takes half damage.
{@b Failure} The creature takes full damage and becomes {@condition Drained|PC1|drained 1}.
{@b Critical Failure} The creature takes double damage and becomes drained 2.
The damage increases by 1d4.

spells.name: Spectral Advance
entries: Taking on a spiritual form, you flash across the battlefield to engage an enemy. You Stride to a space adjacent to an enemy. If you cast the spell using 2 actions, you can Stride twice instead of once. If you have a fly Speed, you can {@action Fly|PC1} instead of Striding. If you're mounted, you can have your mount move instead of you. Movement from {@i spectral advance} doesn't trigger reactions and ignores {@rule Difficult Terrain|PC1|difficult terrain} and greater difficult terrain. During the movement, you (or your mount) have resistance equal to your level to all damage.

spells.name: Spell Riposte
spells.trigger: You’re the target of a spell you’re aware of.
entries: You attempt to counteract the triggering spell. If the spell would be counteracted, it instead continues with the caster as a target instead of you. {@i Spell riposte} can't affect spells that aren't targeted (such as area spells).

spells.name: Spirit Sense
entries: You open your mind to the metaphysical, enabling you to sense nearby spirits. Even if you aren't Searching, you get a check to find {@trait Haunt|GMC|haunts} and {@trait Spirit|PC1|spirits} in the area. You gain a +1 status bonus to the following checks regarding haunts or spirits: Perception checks to {@action Seek|PC1}, attempts to {@action Recall Knowledge|PC1}, skill checks to determine the reason for their existence, and skill checks to disable a haunt. You also gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws against haunts and spirits.
The spell's duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

spells.name: Spirit Song
entries: Your eldritch song sends pulsing waves of ethereal energy to attack creatures' spirits in the area, dealing 14d6 spirit damage that causes their bodies to momentarily freeze up from the hypnotic nature of the tune, depending on the result of their Fortitude save. The vibrating waves of spirit song penetrate into, but not through, solid barriers, damaging {@trait Incorporeal|GMC|incorporeal} creatures hiding in solid objects in the area but not passing onward to damage creatures in other rooms.
{@b Critical Success} The creature takes no damage.
